सिनेमा गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम मसालेदार और धमाकेदार खबर! 🎬
बहुचर्चित फिल्म Ramayana में रावण का किरदार निभाने वाले अभिनेता यश इन दिनों अपनी फिल्म के प्रमोशन में पूरी तरह जुटे हैं। 🍿
Today Stars के साथ हाल ही में हुई बातचीत में यश ने फिल्म के को-स्टार्स रणबीर कपूर, Ravie Dubey और Rakul Preet Singh के साथ अपने अनुभव शेयर किए। 🌟
यश का कहना है कि इस कहानी में Rama और Ravana दोनों पहलुओं से दर्शक जुड़ाव महसूस कर पाएंगे। 🎭
यश ने बताया कि रावण एक विद्वान और योद्धा था, लेकिन लिए गए फैसलों के कारण domino effect होता है। ⚔️
उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि Korean cinema की तरह Indian films को global platform पर दिखाने का यह बिल्कुल सही समय है। 🌍
नितेश तिवारी के निर्देशन और Namit Malhotra की Prime Focus Studios द्वारा निर्मित यह फिल्म दो भागों में आएगी। 🎥
फिल्म का पहला भाग Diwali 2026 यानी 5 नवंबर को रिलीज होगा, जबकि दूसरा भाग Diwali 2027 में आएगा। 📅
इस फिल्म में Ranbir Kapoor राम के, Sai Pallavi सीता के, Yash रावण के और Sunny Deol हनुमान के रोल में नजर आएंगे। ✨
तो दोस्तों, क्या आप बड़े पर्दे पर रामायण देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? 💭

ctx.title: Yash says viewers will be able to relate with both Rama and Ravana in Ramayana, calls it the right time to showcase Indian film to the world
ctx.summary: Ramayana will see Yash take on the role of Ravana. The film releases in theatres on November 5.
ctx.text:
Yash is excited for audience to see Ramayana , where he takes on the character of Ravana. The actor, who has also co-produced the film, is busy promoting the film with the cast and crew these days. In a new interaction with Today Stars, Yash was seen with co-stars Ranbir Kapoor, Ravie Dubey and Rakul Preet Singh as they all shared their experience of working on this film.
Talking about Ramayana, Yash said, “The interpretations of Ramayana is different in each state, different in each language. There are many interpretations and the beauty of our culture is that we see the story from everybody's point of view. Through Ravana's eyes also people have tried to depict the story. So, I feel the beauty of this story is very relatable. There are two aspects of it, when we want to achieve something we learn and dedicate ourselves to some skill. When we get it we become very powerful. After that, to maintain it is also important. In this story, Ravana is a learned scholar, musician and a warrior. But there are elements where the decisions that are made have a domino effect. That is beautifully depicted. One can relate to Rama, one can relate to Ravana… but how Rama has handled situations in life, that is something. To show that, we need Ravana.”
A post shared by The World Of Ramayana (@worldoframayana)
Yash went on to add that he decided to co-produce the film because he felt that the story needed the might and support. He said, “This is the right time to show Indian films to the world platform, like Korean cinema is really making a mark, so India deserves it. So we had that vision and everyone came together.”
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra ’s Prime Focus Studios, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Hindu epic. The ambitious project features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana and Sunny Deol as Hanuman. The film also stars Ravi Dubey, Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan and Lara Dutta.
The film's first instalment is scheduled for a Diwali 2026 release (November 5), with the second part planned for Diwali 2027.
